question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, SUM(ds.points) as total_points, d.constructor_id, c.name
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND d.year = r.year
    JOIN constructors c ON d.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id, d.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(ds.points) > 0
),
min_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM driver_points
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_min_seasons AS (
    SELECT dp.constructor_id, dp.name, COUNT(*) as season_count
    FROM driver_points dp
    JOIN min_per_year mpy ON dp.year = mpy.year
    WHERE dp.total_points = mpy.min_points
    GROUP BY dp.constructor_id, dp.name
)
SELECT name, season_count
FROM constructor_min_seasons
ORDER BY season_count DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 5
